case_name: Add a logo or text overlay
title: Subtle Handle Watermark Throughout
tests: Tests exact handle rendering as a persistent, readable, translucent watermark without changing the source footage or audio.

faults.what: The watermark is extremely large and positioned across the lower center instead of subtly at the bottom right.
A large translucent black rectangle behind the handle obscures much of the cockpit footage; the requested treatment was slightly transparent text with a faint shadow.
The white lettering appears essentially opaque rather than visibly translucent.

judge.summary: The handle is spelled correctly, but oversized lower-center lettering and a large dark backing panel defeat the requested subtle bottom-right watermark.

must_haves.item: The watermark reads exactly '@flightschool' and stays visible throughout the entire clip.
must_haves.why: The exact handle is consistently visible in all four supplied output frames spanning the clip.

must_haves.item: The handle remains fixed at the bottom right with clear space between the text and both frame edges.
must_haves.why: It remains fixed with ample margins, but is centered across the lower portion rather than placed at the bottom right.

must_haves.item: The text is small, white, visibly translucent, and readable against the changing footage, with a subtle shadow.
must_haves.why: It is readable and white, but very large and apparently opaque, with a broad dark backing panel rather than a subtle shadow.

must_haves.item: The original cockpit footage remains unchanged apart from the watermark, with no extra card or scene.
must_haves.why: The cockpit imagery appears consistent with the reference where comparable, but an unrequested large dark panel covers a substantial area of the footage.

must_haves.item: The output lasts 7 seconds and preserves the original synchronized audio.
must_haves.why: The supplied information confirms a seven-second output with speech, but does not establish the original audio or its synchronization.
